notes: Single canonical season reference file. seasons is a DICT keyed by season name (matches season.py).

Each season entry contains BOTH the rich fields (skin_characteristics, best_clothing_colors, lipstick, blush, dress_occasions, hair_colors, eye_makeup, special_notes) AND backward-compatible convenience fields (label, profile, jewelry_simple, lipstick_family, blush_family).
groq_writer.py should read rich_season_data directly from classify_season()["raw_data"] rather than re-loading/re-matching this file itself.
CRITICAL: Rules are matched top-to-bottom, first match wins. Specific rules MUST come before generic rules.

skin_characteristics.pigmentation_notes: Skin is typically warm and clear rather than olive; pigmented lips are less common in this group but when present read as coral-red rather than brown-red. Hyperpigmentation, if any, sits close to skin tone and is easily balanced with warm coral concealer rather than deep correction.

best.name: Warm Coral
best.description: Clear, saturated coral with orange warmth

best.name: Poppy Red
best.description: Vivid warm red with no brown or blue cast

lipstick.pigmented_lips_note: Naturally pigmented lips in this group should choose clear, saturated corals or warm reds rather than muted or brown-based shades, which flatten the natural brightness of the coloring.

hair_colors.highlight_notes: Golden and copper highlights amplify the natural warmth and clarity; avoid ashy or cool-toned dye jobs which flatten contrast.

special_notes.pigmented_lips: Choose clear warm coral or red-orange shades; steer clear of muted or brown-toned lipsticks that dull the natural brightness.
special_notes.hyperpigmentation: Correct with warm peach-toned concealer; avoid yellow or gray correctors that clash with the clear warm undertone.
special_notes.olive_skin: True Bright Spring olive is rare, but if warm-olive with high clarity, lean into clear jewel tones (turquoise, grass green) rather than muted earth tones.
